$comment: Canonical, machine-checkable merge-gate policy for MarkFlow-private.
This file is the single source of truth for which pull request checks are required,
which are staged for later promotion, which are advisory, and which are release-only.
.github/scripts/hardening-audit.sh compares the required set against the workflows that
actually produce those contexts and, when authenticated for repository administration,
against the live branch ruleset. A staged context is deliberately not claimed as required
until the live ruleset has been safely promoted in the same control change.
Keep this file in sync in the same pull request that changes a workflow job name.

required.covers: Kotlin/Gradle compile, webview TypeScript production build, plugin packaging
Gradle check (Kotlin unit tests) and the webview source test suite
Qodana static analysis; this job, not the Qodana annotation check, is authoritative
IntelliJ plugin structure verification and Plugin Verifier compatibility targets

staged_required.covers: This policy vs. its workflow producers, plus the audit's own fail-closed negative tests
staged_required.promotion: After this workflow is merged and observed on main and ordinary pull requests, add this exact context to the live ruleset and move this entry to required in the same change.

advisory.reason: Posted by the Qodana action itself and renamed with the linter edition (it has already appeared as both 'Qodana Community for JVM' and 'Qodana for JVM'). An unstable context name must never be a required check; the 'Inspect code' job is the authoritative gate.

release_only.reason: Guarded by `if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'`, so it reports as skipped on every pull request and must never be required.

$comment: Checks the audit runs. `gate` checks run on every pull request and fail the build.
`report` checks run in the scheduled drift audit only, and are staged this way when the
repository cannot pass them yet. Promoting a check is a one-word change here.

staged.blocked_by: PR #50 owns .github/workflows/build.yml and cannot be edited from this branch without conflicting.
staged.when: after PR #50 and PR #53 land and every `uses:` in .github/workflows is pinned to a full 40-character commit SHA

staged.blocked_by: build.yml declares no workflow-level `permissions:` block and is owned by PR #50.
staged.when: after build.yml declares an explicit least-privilege `permissions:` block

staged.blocked_by: .github/workflows/pr-labeler.yml is introduced by PR #53 and is not on main yet.
.github/labeler.yml and the issue forms are introduced by PR #53 and are not on main yet.
Requires repository-administration read access; the ordinary GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read every accepted live setting.
staged.when: only if a least-privilege HARDENING_AUDIT_TOKEN or equivalent GitHub App credential is provisioned; without it scheduled runs explicitly skip live readback rather than claiming success

staged.blocked_by: 'Hardening audit' is introduced by this pull request, so it is not yet required by the live ruleset.
staged.when: after the context is observed on main and ordinary pull requests, move it from staged_required to required while adding it to the 'main protection' ruleset
